about: Whether a reply queued for when a chat's turn ends still waits (afterTurnWaits), by the chat's row (cases), and whether Talpy Chat says when a refused one is tried again (queuedRetryAt; retry: its refused, error, startAt this many ms from now). Read by both front ends' tests: tests/test_pane.py runs Plasma's main.qml functions in node, vscode/test/queue.test.ts the TypeScript one (core/src/shared/model.ts).

cases.what: a background chat whose turn is over, its background work going on
in its Claude Code panel, its turn over
a terminal that takes no text, its turn over
a terminal that takes no text, idle

retry.what: refused, tried again in a minute
refused, its try's time has come
refused, then Start it now failed
never refused, waiting for a usage limit
